_comment: Three AI-generated Soft & Natural variations per focal point (Objective 6). Every variation uses the SAME recommended shades for the detected tone (shown on the Shades screen) - so the virtual try-on there stays accurate. The variations differ only in COVERAGE / intensity: how sheer or full the look is, driven by 'intensity' per step. The focal step always carries the strongest, most distinct difference (sheer -> balanced -> full).

lips.name: Bare Petal
lips.desc: The softest reading of Soft & Natural. A sheer wash of your lip shade, everything else kept almost invisible.

lips.name: Soft Focus
lips.desc: The balanced everyday version. Defined lips in your recommended shade with just enough warmth on the cheeks.

lips.name: Rosy Statement
lips.desc: The fullest coverage - the same lip shade built up richer, so the lips carry the whole look.

eyebrows.name: Feathered
eyebrows.desc: Light, hair-like strokes that follow your natural brow shape. Nothing is squared off or filled solid.

eyebrows.name: Softly Defined
eyebrows.desc: The balanced version. Brows filled evenly through the body with the front kept soft.

eyebrows.name: Structured
eyebrows.desc: The fullest coverage - the same brow shade built up richer, with a clearer arch and tail.

cheeks.name: Sheer Veil
cheeks.desc: A barely-there flush placed high on the apples. Reads like natural colour rather than product.

cheeks.name: Soft Glow
cheeks.desc: The balanced version. A warm, blended flush swept upward along the cheekbone.

cheeks.name: Sun-washed
cheeks.desc: The fullest coverage - the same blush built up warmer and carried further toward the temple.

contour.name: Whisper Sculpt
contour.desc: The lightest shaping. A soft shadow under the cheekbone with no hard edges anywhere.

contour.name: Soft Sculpt
contour.desc: The balanced version. Cheekbone, jaw and nose shaped just enough to read in normal light.

contour.name: Defined Sculpt
contour.desc: The fullest coverage - the same contour shade built up deeper through the cheekbone and jaw.
